SD26-014.name: Dragonic Wall
SD26-014.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate you control +5000 BP. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
By destroying a Red Spirit you control, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step. This effect can only be used during (Opposing Attack Step).

SD26-013.name: Fatal Draw
SD26-013.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. If your Life is at two or less, also, draw a card.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +2000 BP.

SD26-004.name: Ryuuman-Rebellion
SD26-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

SD26-007.name: Ryuuman-Skyhigh
SD26-007.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Battles)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, this Ultimate gains +10000 BP.
[utb]

[LV4] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Ryuuman"-named Spirit/Ultimate attacks, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

SD26-002.name: Ryuuman-Charger
SD26-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Ryuuman"-named Spirits/Ultimates gain +1000 BP.

SD26-003.name: Ryuuman-Wisword
SD26-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[When Braved] [LV2]
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

SD26-015.name: Sunbreaker
SD26-015.effect:
[Trigger Counter]
When an opposing Ultimate Trigger hits, if this Magic card is in your Hand, you can use the following effect before the "When hits" effect activates.

█ Draw two cards. Also, if the hit card is a Red card, treat it as a Guard.

[Flash]
During this turn, when only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP with your Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD26-005.name: Testarossa-Dragon
SD26-005.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.

SD26-012.name: The Big Flagship Dragnic
SD26-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
You draw +1 card.

SD26-011.name: The Burning Sacred Place of Dragons
SD26-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "Ryuuman"-named Spirits/Ultimates are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits/Ultimates gain +3000 BP.

SD26-009.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 3 or more Ultimate]

[LV1] (Your Main Step)
While this Brave is in Spirit condition, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

[When Braved] (Your Main Step)
This Ultimate gains an extra Red symbol.

SD26-010.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 3 or more Spirit/Ultimate]

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return a Red Cost 5 or less Ultimate card from your Trash to the Hand.

Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[When Braved] (When this Ultimate Brave Attacks)
When Ultimate Trigger hits, this Ultimate gains +7000 BP.

[When Braved] [Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Brave Attacks)]

[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[When Braved] [LV3][LV4][LV5]
This Ultimate gains an extra Red symbol.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate-Trigger hits, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. When this Ultimate is braved, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate instead.
[utb]

SD26-006.name: Ultimate-Bronze-Wurm
SD26-006.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]

[LV4]
Increase the limit of your Ultimate's "BP Destruction effects" by +2000.
